text:
maria: Drafting Dedicated capacity plan for Q3 — need GPU + region benchmark comparisons and concurrency targets. Please paste latency/throughput charts, kernel choices, and any quality regressions from quant experiments. Link to draft: https://internal.redwood/dedicated/q3-capacity

ajay: Ran a 3-region sweep (us-west1 / eu-west1 / ap-south1) for redwood-30b across fp16, int8, int4. Quick summary: a100(fp16/int8) stable p50/p95; h100 shows better p99 under load but int4 on h100 is noisy at high concurrency. Throughput gains vs fp16: int8 ~1.4x, int4 ~1.9-2.2x depending on kernel.

sara: Concurrency baseline question — what are we targeting per GPU for chat SLOs? Historically we used 8 concurrent sessions for 30b int8 on a100. If int4 increases throughput, we still need to reserve headroom for tail latency.

ajay: Tentative numbers from the sweep: a100@int8 -> 8 ccs gives p99 ~210ms on us-west; a100@int4 -> 12 ccs gives p99 ~320ms (tails rise). h100@int8 -> 10 ccs p99 ~190ms; h100@int4 -> 14 ccs p99 ~260ms but higher variance in eu region.

ajay: Quick sim command I used:
```
python tools/sim_capacity.py --model redwood-30b --gpus a100 --quant int4 --region us-west1 --concurrency 12 --slo 250
```

leo: Autoscale + headroom ops note — we should reserve 20% capacity for warm failover and pre-warm windows for canary rolls. Also pre-warm policy needs a prefetch of KV cache for models with long context.

sara: From sizing perspective my proposal: steady concurrency target = 6 per GPU for int8 (conservative), burst to 12 with autoscale for traffic spikes. For int4, run as experimental with 30% reduced steady concurrency and strict eval gating.

ajay: Quant evals: int4 shows larger semantic drift on long-context summarization tests. On our internal conv-long eval: ROUGE drop ~2.1 pts, hallucination rate +0.8% compared to fp16. Performance wins are good but tradeoff exists.

quant-bot: Automated eval summary uploaded: /evals/1854321000/int4_vs_int8_summary.csv — metrics: [rouge_delta: "-2.1", hallucination_delta: "+0.8%", latency_p50/p95/p99_by_region: "us-west: 120/180/260, eu-west: 130/200/310, ap-south: 140/220/340"]

maria: Can we size a Dedicated pool that meets p99 SLO = 250ms for chat traffic in us-west1? If not, plan fallback to fp16 or route to h100 for p99-critical customers. Need GPU counts + monthly cost delta.

infra-bot: Cost projection (rough): a100 reserved pool (100 GPUs) monthly = "$150k"; h100 reserved pool (75 GPUs) monthly = "$190k". With 20% headroom included, switching primary p99 traffic to h100 increases monthly infra cost by ~18%. (numbers are mock; run cost-runner for exact).

leo: Kernel selection note — fused-attn-v2 on h100 gives large int4 perf wins but requires driver >=525 and patched cuBLAS. We need runtime flag to gate kernel: --kernel=auto|fused-v2|fallback. Also add a safe-fallback that disables fused kernels for customers with strict determinism.

ajay: I'll run final scale sims across 1..300 GPUs and produce CSV with p50/p95/p99 curves + cost. Command I'm running now:
```
python tools/sim_capacity.py --model redwood-30b --quant int8,int4,fp16 --regions us-west1,eu-west1,ap-south1 --gpus a100,h100 --scale 1..300 --out /tmp/capacity_sweep_1854321000.csv
```

sara: Proposal for Dedicated quoting: mix pool strategy — primary a100 in NA, h100 in EU for p99 customers, set advertised concurrency: a100=6 steady/12 burst, h100=8 steady/14 burst for int8. Int4 only for opt-in experimental customers behind eval gating.

maria: Thanks — can everyone drop CSVs and charts here by EOD? We need to lock commit numbers for Dedicated quoting next week. @sara @leo @ajay :thumbsup:

sara: ack :thumbsup:

leo: will add kernel gating PR and driver-check in runtime by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: uploading results now — /tmp/capacity_sweep_1854321000.csv (upload should appear in CI artifacts).

quant-bot: upload complete: /evals/1854321000-int4-vs-int8.csv

maria: Perfect — after we have the CSVs we'll finalize counts + cost deltas and update the quote doc.
